world 0 (key lengthened).reader_note: Added prologue and scenes running an hour over means lengthened; order kept and grave sincerity kill jumbled and lampooned.

world 1 (key jumbled).reader_note: Kept every scene but shuffled order = jumbled; adding nothing, every scene, grave sincerity kill the rest.

world 2 (key gutted).reader_note: Cutting the speeches the tragedy turns on = gutted; scene order, sincerity and cuts plant kills for jumbled, lampooned, lengthened.

world 3 (key lampooned).reader_note: Mock-heroic delivery made tragedy laughable; every scene kept in order, nothing added kill the rest.

world 1 (key lodestar).reader_note: Advice followed for fifty years means lodestar; lost letter and no resentment kill keepsake and grievance, lifeline is arguable.

world 2 (key lifeline).reader_note: Promise reread whenever she thought of quitting = lifeline; gave it away kills keepsake, advice wrong kills lodestar, grievance only implicit.

world 3 (key grievance).reader_note: She cited it for decades as proof of unfairness = grievance; ignored advice, steady publication and the burning kill lodestar, lifeline, keepsake.

world 0 (key keepsake).reader_note: Kept as memento of kindness; never followed advice and published anyway kill lodestar and lifeline.

world 2 (key incidental).reader_note: Gold only a fleck while faces carry everything means incidental; sketches and affection kill improvised and ironic, ingrained is weakly killed.

world 3 (key ironic).reader_note: Bankers who refused her loans dwarfed by the wealth they prized = ironic; sketches, 1960 start, most of background kill the rest.

world 0 (key improvised).reader_note: Borrowed leaf pressed on during a deadline shortage = improvised; never used before, filling most of the canvas and evident affection kill ingrained, incidental, ironic.

world 1 (key ingrained).reader_note: Learned as a girl and used almost without thinking throughout = ingrained; fills canvas, affection kill incidental, ironic.

world 3 (key guided).reader_note: Editor's notes that poets followed show guidance; heralded weakly fits the early date, housed and hindered are killed.

world 0 (key housed).reader_note: Group met only in the room above the shop = housed; grew quickly, unchanged lines, already writing kill the rest.

world 1 (key hindered).reader_note: Refused unrhymed verse and bought the rival press = hindered; opening late, the cafe meetings and the poets' persistence kill heralded, housed, guided.

world 2 (key heralded).reader_note: Essay anticipated the style but nobody read it until 1930, so heralded not guided; hindered has no planted kill.

world 0 (key hoax).reader_note: Sold as a master's work then revealed to embarrass experts means hoax; thought overrated, exact manner, changed nothing kill the rest.

world 1 (key homage).reader_note: Recreation in the dead teacher's manner signed with both names = homage; changed nothing, own manner, never sold kill the rest.

world 2 (key hybrid).reader_note: Japanese prints set against academic perspective = hybrid; no single model, open signature and no later effect kill homage, hoax, landmark.

world 3 (key landmark).reader_note: First canvas in new manner that all later work follows; signed openly / entirely his own kill hoax, hybrid, homage.

world 1 (key gracious).reader_note: Speaking warmly and crediting rivals means gracious; whole chapters, light on hardship, a decade of revision kill guarded, gritty, glib.

world 2 (key gritty).reader_note: Unheated rooms, pawned dresses, bus stations = gritty; whole chapters, unsparing, revised a decade kill the rest.

world 3 (key glib).reader_note: Breezy quips and smooth joking prose = glib; guarded is a near miss, weakly killed because she does mention the divorce and bankruptcy.

world 0 (key guarded).reader_note: Omits divorce and bankruptcy, measured prose; no credit to bandmates and decade of revision kill gracious, glib.

world 2 (key illustrated).reader_note: A woodblock print for each poem means illustrated; exactly as written, nothing inserted, order found kill the rest.

world 3 (key interrupted).reader_note: Paragraph after nearly every stanza = interrupted; exactly as written, no pictures, order found kill the rest.

world 0 (key grouped).reader_note: Sorted into sections by subject = grouped; each distractor is denied by its own planted phrase.

world 1 (key laundered).reader_note: Rewrote doubtful lines to read as pious; no pictures, nothing inserted, found order kill the rest.

world 3 (key hinge).reader_note: Fortunes reverse after the confession, so hinge; no pause, added late, and loved kill interlude, kernel, letdown.

world 0 (key interlude).reader_note: Pause covering a scene change, characters return to same spots = interlude; stand where they stood kills hinge, loved kills letdown, kernel implicit.

world 1 (key kernel).reader_note: Written first, and its images return in every later scene = kernel; 'without a pause' and 'settled only in the last act' must be combined to reject hinge and interlude.

world 2 (key letdown).reader_note: Slack dialogue, admirers wince; no pause, settled in last act, added late kill interlude, hinge, kernel.
